items.quote: - [x] **HIPP-11**: A HippoRAG query returns at most top_k items and evidence refs
- [x] **HIPP-12**: A HippoRAG query run dispatches only query-side nodes
- [x] **HIPP-13**: The HippoRAG envelope answer is not an inline copy of evidence content
- [x] **HIPP-14**: When a HippoRAG query takes a declared degradation path
- [x] **HIPP-15**: Job, corpus and health status cover HippoRAG
- [x] **HIPP-16**: HippoRAG supports document delete and clean re-ingest
- [x] **HIPP-17**: An EvidenceRef minted by a HippoRAG query never resolves silently to different text
- [x] **HIPP-18**: Every config key in wirings/hipporag/base.json and wirings/hipporag/corpus-ingest.json is either read by its part body or removed.
- [x] **HIPP-19**: HippoRAG ingest token accounting never reports tokens from different counters under one counted_by label
